description_en: This API is used to retrieve the distribution data of usage statistics
description_zh: 本接口用于获取用量统计的分布数据
name: DescribeUsageDistributionStatData

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query, expressed as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query, expressed as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en:
The statistics dimension. Valid values:  
CHANNEL_ONLINE: Statistics by channel online user count.  
NETWORK: Statistics by network type.  
OS: Statistics by operating system type
parameters.help_zh:
统计维度。取值：
CHANNEL_ONLINE：按照频道在线人数统计。
NETWORK：按照网络类型统计。
OS：按照系统类型统计
parameters.name: stat_dim

Name.description_en:
The statistics dimension. Valid values:  
When StatDim is CHANNEL_ONLINE, valid values are: ONE_TO_FIVE (1–5 people), SIX_TO_TEN (6–10 people), ELEVEN_TO_TWENTY (11–20 people), TWENTY_ONE_TO_FIFTY (21–50 people), ABOVE_FIFTY (more than 50 people).  
When StatDim is NETWORK, valid values include: WiFi, 4G, etc.  
When StatDim is OS, valid values include: iOS, Android, etc
Name.description_zh:
统计维度。取值：
当StatDim为CHANNEL_ONLINE时，取值：ONE_TO_FIVE（1~5人）、SIX_TO_TEN（6~10人）、ELEVEN_TO_TWENTY（11~20人）、TWENTY_ONE_TO_FIFTY（21~50人）、ABOVE_FIFTY（50人以上）。  
当StatDim为NETWORK时，取值：WiFi、4G等。  
当StatDim为OS时，取值：iOS、Android等
